pages.text: Lumen Grazer — peaceful herd grazer (breed with Glowberries).$(br)Shade Stalker — fast dark predator that flees light.$(br)Lantern Beetle — glowing flyer; bottle it for a lamp.$(br)Sporeling — jungle/cave swarm; bursts a spore cloud.$(br)Mirelurker — $(l:moonmire)Moonmire$(/l) ambusher.

Lumen Fish — schooling glow-fish (bucketable).$(br)Sky Jelly — harmless air drifter.$(br)Glowmoth — flower guardian; turns hostile if you break a bloom near it.$(br)Rootback — huge, slow, tanky turtle.$(br)Crag Wraith — flying crags hunter.$(br)$(l:echo_sentinel)Echo Sentinel$(/l) — the ruin guardian.$(br)$(br)What each one drops is good for something — see $(l:drops_and_uses)Drops & Their Uses$(/l).
